data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for scanning and transmitting iBeacons on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to range, monitor, and advertise iBeacon packets. Handles permission checks and platform-specific setup automatically.
use_when: You need BLE beacon ranging or monitoring in a Flutter app
You want to advertise as an iBeacon from a Flutter device
avoid_when: You only need simple Bluetooth LE scanning without iBeacon support
You are targeting platforms other than Android/iOS
weaknesses: No support for other beacon types
data.setup_notes: Add required Android permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and iOS Info.plist, request runtime permissions via initializeAndCheckScanning, ensure location services enabled
